description: Two attenuators in 2HP, each with a knob and a CV input, running from silence to unity gain and no further

params.text: Sets that section's gain, 0x fully counter-clockwise to 1x fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts that section's amplify CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Makes the B knobs follow the A knobs while it is green, greying the B pair out

inputs.text: Moves that section's gain; 10V here covers the knob's full travel at full trim, and the total is held between 0x and 1x
The signal to be attenuated by that section

outputs.text: Carries that section's input at the gain its knob and CV set, with as many channels as that input has

notes: the B input reads the A input when its own jack is empty, and the B amplify CV reads the A amplify CV, so one signal and one control voltage can feed both sections
the B amplify normalling has no effect until the B trim knob is turned off its centre, because the trim scales the CV before it is added
menu: Scaling-mode: Exp, Linear, Log — bends the response of the amplify knobs; the light beside the Amp. label is dark for Linear, green for Exp and red for Log
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A-VCA input; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.3:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A input.
